caption: The drawing features a symmetrical design composed of several colored elements on a textured beige background. At the top, there is a stylized yellow cross with red and blue accents and yellow radiating lines behind it. Below the cross, there is a bow-like shape with four looping ends, outlined in blue with red and yellow interiors and a circular center with blue, red, and yellow patterns. Flanking the bow are two yellow wing-like shapes with red tips. At the bottom of the composition, there is a large circular medallion filled with a geometric starburst pattern using yellow, red, and blue lines and shapes, with a central blue and yellow circle. The overall color palette consists of muted yellows, reds, and blues.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
